explication_en: RSVP Reader is a Svelte speed-reading application: App.svelte assembles the word-by-word display, the controls and the text input. PDF or EPUB files are extracted by file-parsers.js, the pace is computed by rsvp-utils.js and progress is saved by progress-storage.js.
